items.title: Solana Changelog: August 13, 2026
items.whyYouShouldCare: Updates in the Solana Changelog indicate ongoing infrastructure improvements that may enhance network performance and attract more developers.

items.title: Solana’s fee overhaul increases burn and makes resource hogs pay
items.whyYouShouldCare: The fee overhaul aims to increase token burn and penalize high-resource users, potentially improving SOL's scarcity and incentivizing efficient usage.

items.title: Bitwise mulls tokenizing its Solana staking ETF via Superstate partnership
items.whyYouShouldCare: Bitwise's potential tokenization of its Solana staking ETF could increase institutional interest and liquidity in the Solana ecosystem.
